name: Vanquish the Betrayers
summary: At Tiragarde Keep, Kul Tiran forces hold a coastal foothold in Durotar. Gar'Thok has ordered a Horde strike against Lieutenant Benedict's garrison, whose presence breaks the fragile peace with Theramore.

sections.title: A Shattered Truce
sections.body: Thrall led the Horde across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, where he joined Lady Jaina Proudmoore against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Peace broke when Jaina's estranged father, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, brought Kul Tiras's navy to Durotar. He blamed all orcs for the Old Horde's atrocities and seized coastal footholds, including Tiragarde Keep. Daelin died at Theramore, but remnants of his fleet still refuse any pact or surrender their hatred.

sections.title: Benedict's Resurgence
sections.body: Tiragarde Keep fell briefly after the Grand Admiral's defeat, then Kul Tiras reserves under Lieutenant Benedict retook it. The fortress lies between Razor Hill and Sen'jin Village. From there, sailors and marines harass travelers and threaten Durotar's eastern sea approaches. Gar'Thok sees their position as an immediate danger to Durotar's security and calls on Horde warriors to strike at Benedict's command.

faq.q: Why are Kul Tiran humans attacking Durotar?
faq.answer: They are remnants of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's expeditionary fleet. Daelin rejected peaceful coexistence between humans and orcs and sought to destroy Durotar. Even after his death, his loyalists still occupy coastal strongholds such as Tiragarde Keep, defying the Horde.

Lieutenant Benedict commands the Kul Tiran reserves holding Tiragarde Keep. After Grand Admiral Proudmoore's defeat, Benedict rallied the surviving marines and sailors, retook the coastal fortification, and began persistent operations against the orcs.

faq.q: Does Jaina Proudmoore support these humans?
faq.answer: No. Jaina made a pact with Warchief Thrall for mutual survival and actively opposed her father's aggressive crusade to preserve peace. The troops at Tiragarde Keep are Kul Tiras remnants who reject Theramore's diplomacy and see Jaina's truce as treason.

Gar'Thok calls them betrayers because their invasion broke the understanding Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore forged to defeat Archimonde in the Third War. Their continued military presence in sovereign Horde territory defies the post-war boundaries established on Kalimdor.

Tiragarde Keep stands on Durotar's eastern coast, south of Razor Hill and just northeast of Sen'jin Village. Its high stone walls overlook the coastal waters, giving the invaders a strategic base near Horde settlements.

angles.text: The Kul Tiran occupation of Tiragarde Keep is an ongoing act of war on Durotar's threshold. Driving out Benedict's forces shows the Horde can defend its newly settled home from foreign fleets.
Orcs honor the truce with Jaina at Mount Hyjal, but Kul Tiras brings bitter memories of the Second War. Fighting Benedict's marines is a matter of survival and ancestral pride.
Tiragarde Keep lies uncomfortably close to Sen'jin Village, the Darkspear settlement. Driving out its hostile sailors helps protect the trolls' vulnerable new home.
